name: Poseidong
source:
Captain of the Moustache Pirates. An orphan taken in by the previous captain, he grew up aboard a pirate ship. Because of his fur colour, some suspect that he may be connected to the royal family.

[From [url=https://pirahus.com/en/]official website[/url]]
